staticFrame.alt: An illustrated survey atlas on warm paper. Four ink-blue schema districts rise beside a drawn route and a read-only gate at the edge of the map.

scenes.label: 01 / The cartographer’s fold
scenes.heading:
Every question
needs a way
*through.*
scenes.lead:
A small atlas of mistakes, corrections,
and the limits of arriving.
scenes.narration: QueryPilot turns natural language into inspectable, read-only SQL. Unfold its world with your scroll.

scenes.label: 02 / A question sets out
scenes.heading:
Start with
a question.
scenes.lead: One actual question. One recorded journey.
scenes.narration: The map is a metaphor. The question and final SQL come from the committed `hard_001` evaluation record.

scenes.label: 03 / Find the territory
scenes.heading:
You can’t cross
an unknown city.
scenes.narration: The recorded context contains orders, customers, order_items and products. Their architecture and positions are invented for this atlas; they are not a database plan.

scenes.label: 04 / A possible crossing
scenes.heading:
A route is
only a proposal.
scenes.lead: The generator writes SQL. The checks get a say.
scenes.narration: Static criticism, safety checks and database execution can reject a statement that looks convincing. A drawn line does not make a bridge.

scenes.label: 05 / The first attempt
scenes.heading:
Almost
isn’t across.
scenes.lead: The first attempt did not succeed.
scenes.narration: The Day 6 record preserves that result and the final SQL. It does not preserve the SQL or failure reason for every intermediate attempt. The broken bridge illustrates failure; it does not diagnose it.

scenes.label: 06 / Bounded correction
scenes.heading:
Draw again.
Know when to stop.
scenes.lead: This recorded query took three attempts.
scenes.narration: Structured failure feedback can return to the correction path. The attempt budget is bounded; cosmetic rewrites do not earn endless retries.

scenes.label: 07 / The read-only gate
scenes.heading:
A crossing isn’t
permission.
scenes.lead: Correction must not erase the guardrails.
scenes.narration: Safety is checked again after correction. Database acceptance alone cannot authorize destructive or sensitive intent. Try the boundary in this illustration.

scenes.label: 08 / The honest ledger
scenes.heading:
Four more
made it through.
scenes.narration: Correction recovered four of seven initial failures on the core benchmark. The 12 adversarial questions are a separate set, testing a different contract.

scenes.label: 09 / The edge of the map
scenes.heading:
It ran.
*Did it answer?*
scenes.lead: Arriving is not the same as being right.
scenes.narration: Execution success does not establish whether the SQL answered the intended business question. That is the next evaluation boundary, and where this atlas stops.

audio.explanation: This world is a silent illustrated atlas. It has no audio asset and makes no audio request.
